column1: # The bridge between doc/verification.md and tb/tests/. One line per runnable
# test; tab-separated; '#' starts a comment line.
#   T-id <TAB> uvm_test <TAB> wp <TAB> requirements <TAB> timeout_s <TAB> red
# T-id          must match the ID used in doc/verification.md (T-01, T-06, ...)
# uvm_test      the UVM test class name, i.e. tb/tests/<uvm_test>.sv
# wp            the work package that owns the test (0 = baseline / pilot)
# requirements  comma-separated FR-NN ids the test is evidence for, '-' if none
# timeout_s     hard wall-clock limit for one xsim run, in seconds
# red           yes: the work-package gate requires a recorded red run (`--record red`)
#               at a different rtl_digest before the test can count as evidence
#               no:  the test predates the flow and has no red record
# A test listed here must exist in tb/tests/<uvm_test>.sv. After adding a line,
# re-run ./configure so CMake picks up the new sim_<uvm_test> target.
# wp 0 - baseline: the tests that existed before the work-package flow
